mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_outbound WHERE outbound_no = #{outboundNo} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT * FROM inventory_outbound WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT * FROM inventory_outbound WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_outbound SET status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_at = #{confirmedAt}, operator = #{operator}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND status = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE inventory_outbound SET status = 'CANCELLED', version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND status = 'DRAFT'

UPDATE inventory_outbound SET warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}, remark = #{remark}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.outbound_no, o.warehouse_id, o.status, o.remark, o.confirmed_at, o.operator, o.version, o.created_at, o.updated_at, w.warehouse_code, w.name AS warehouse_name FROM inventory_outbound o LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id WHERE o.deleted = FALSE AND o.id = #{id}
